pr_body:
when we attempt to load trained models nodes, we should wait for the inference indices primary shards to be available before attempting to load the models. Otherwise attempting to load the models is a waste of time and could cause errors.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/85438
pr_title: [ML] ensure that inference index primary shards are available before attempting to load model
pr_comment: Hi @benwtrent, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: This should not be required with the other changes.

@davidkyle It ensures that the index is around before even bothering to wait around for the model. Correct, it doesn't do anything for the node assignment/allocation. But since the trigger trained model loading is in 5s intervals, I thought it good to not bother waiting for that until shards are available.
